@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The c______y is so famous that almost everyone knows who she is.
= celebrity
~詞義 celebrity（n.）名人
~原文 The celebrity is so famous that almost everyone knows who she is.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The woman was o______med with grief when she learned that her husband had died in the accident.
= overwhelmed
~詞義 overwhelm（v.）使不知所措
~原文 The woman was overwhelmed with grief when she learned that her husband had died in the accident.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I am sorry that I won't be able to come to the meeting. I have a p______r engagement.
= prior
~詞義 prior（adj.）在先的
~原文 I am sorry that I won't be able to come to the meeting. I have a prior engagement.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The smartphone company claims that they have achieved a technological b______h by dramatically reducing the weight of their phones.
= breakthrough
~詞義 breakthrough（n.）突破
~原文 The smartphone company claims that they have achieved a technological breakthrough by dramatically reducing the weight of their phones.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The house does not have enough s______e space, so Peter is unable to store all his belongings.
= storage
~詞義 storage（n.）儲存
~原文 The house does not have enough storage space, so Peter is unable to store all his belongings.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In recent years, scientists have observed a(n) ______ change in the temperature on Earth; in other words, it is obviously getting warmer.
A: administrative
B: horizontal
C: noticeable
D: structural
= C
~詞義 noticeable（adj.）顯著的
~原文 In recent years, scientists have observed a(n) noticeable change in the temperature on Earth; in other words, it is obviously getting warmer.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The speaker was talking so softly that the audience members had to ______ their ears to hear her.
A: suspend
B: mock
C: scheme
D: strain
= D
~詞義 strain（v.）拉緊;豎起
~原文 The speaker was talking so softly that the audience members had to strain their ears to hear her.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Andy has a severe ______ to peanuts. He starts to cough and itch if he goes near any.
A: allergy
B: mortality
C: particle
D: spectator
= A
~詞義 allergy（n.）過敏
~原文 Andy has a severe allergy to peanuts. He starts to cough and itch if he goes near any.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The report shows that the building company failed to take safety ______ when setting up the construction site. That's what led to the tragic accident.
A: arenas
B: components
C: precautions
D: segments
= C
~詞義 precaution（n.）預防措施
~原文 The report shows that the building company failed to take safety precautions when setting up the construction site. That's what led to the tragic accident.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Ken did not tell others about his marriage because he likes to keep a low ______.
A: administrator
B: profile
C: pulse
D: warrior
= B
~詞義 profile（n.）低調(low profile)
~原文 Ken did not tell others about his marriage because he likes to keep a low profile.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bodyguard
B: patented
C: indispensable
D: reversed
E: recommends
F: straightforward

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: We cannot start the meeting until William arrives; he is a(n) ______ member of our team.
= C
~詞義 indispensable（adj.）必不可少的
~原文 We cannot start the meeting until William arrives; he is a(n) indispensable member of our team.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: It can be hard to deliver bad news to someone; in fact, the best way to do it is to be honest and ______.
= F
~詞義 straightforward（adj.）直率的
~原文 It can be hard to deliver bad news to someone; in fact, the best way to do it is to be honest and straightforward.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Once Ian ______ the software, he felt relieved that his idea was legally protected.
= B
~詞義 patent（v.）取得專利
~原文 Once Ian patented the software, he felt relieved that his idea was legally protected.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The doctor ______ that my grandfather stop drinking alcohol to avoid worsening his heart disease.
= E
~詞義 recommend（v.）建議
~原文 The doctor recommends that my grandfather stop drinking alcohol to avoid worsening his heart disease.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The driver carefully ______ her vehicle out of the narrow lane to avoid hitting the fence behind her.
= D
~詞義 reverse（v.）倒車
~原文 The driver carefully reversed her vehicle out of the narrow lane to avoid hitting the fence behind her.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: spectacular
B: sturdy
C: strapped
D: administration
E: preyed
F: depression

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: I have used this desk for more than twenty years without a glitch. It is a very ______ piece of furniture.
= B
~詞義 sturdy（adj.）堅固的
~原文 I have used this desk for more than twenty years without a glitch. It is a very sturdy piece of furniture.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tina has a lot of experience in business ______; she is good at managing people and organizing work schedules.
= D
~詞義 administration（n.）行政
~原文 Tina has a lot of experience in business administration; she is good at managing people and organizing work schedules.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The documentary showed how stronger animals ______ upon weaker ones to survive in the wild.
= E
~詞義 prey（v.）捕食
~原文 The documentary showed how stronger animals preyed upon weaker ones to survive in the wild.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: During the economic ______, many factories closed, leaving thousands of workers without a stable income.
= F
~詞義 depression（n.）經濟蕭條
~原文 During the economic depression, many factories closed, leaving thousands of workers without a stable income.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before the plane takes off, the flight attendants will walk around the cabin to make sure that everyone is ______ in.
= C
~詞義 strap（adj.）繫好安全帶;用帶子捆綁
~原文 Before the plane takes off, the flight attendants will walk around the cabin to make sure that everyone is strapped in.
